description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for credit decision logic related to persistence cleanup actions, including parameters such as interval, metric report timeout, timer threshold, and credit per batch, along with an enum for default config values.

classes.name: CreditDecisionConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration methods for credit decision parameters related to cleanup actions.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns how often the credit decision is made, i.e., the delay between successive decisions.

methods.name: getMetricReportTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum wait time for metric reports before considering the operation failed.

methods.name: getTimerThreshold
methods.description: Returns the maximum database latency tolerated before limiting cleanup actions.

methods.name: getCreditPerBatch
methods.description: Returns the amount of credit issued per decision, controlling the rate of cleanup actions.
